about: Parts where a person or agent read both the listing and the PDF (#799, #810). Shared catalogues count as one datasheet. Listing figures for the first 50 rows are from the boards' parts.json at hw-lab 0d7ee07 and hwde-boards 2ad36de; the passive and discrete rows after them (#810) at hw-lab cf35a3bc and hwde-boards 9582524, read 2026-11-16 by agents from LCSC's PDF for each part (not an independent read). The last 47 rows (#810) are supply rows from the errata training corpus's listings, each read by an agent from the corpus PDF for both its recommended top (datasheet_v) and its absolute maximum (abs_max_v), so a listing can be judged low against the first and high only past the second; also not an independent read. A part LCSC served another maker's PDF for, or another revision's, is left out.
